assumptions.decision: Rich nested reusable blocks are grouped into business-readable steps when individual leaf steps would expose UI mechanics.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A BA may expect more granular wording for a particular business operation.
assumptions.mitigation: Every recursive leaf is classified in Reports/EXECUTABLE-LEAF-ACCOUNTING-V29.json; review-required leaves are never silently dropped.

assumptions.decision: Repeated non-parameterized setup is represented as Background; technical setup is in Hooks.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A prerequisite that changes business state may be hidden as setup.
assumptions.mitigation: Background conversion is limited to stable setup phrases; business postconditions remain visible.

assumptions.decision: One final locator is emitted per used field, selected from the effective Module/submodule tree.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A fallback XPath or text locator may be fragile.
assumptions.mitigation: Fallback selectors are annotated REVIEW and counted in Reports/LOCATOR-CONFIDENCE-V29.json.

assumptions.decision: Duplicate aliases such as State/State Abbv collapse to StateCode only when they represent the same semantic dimension.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A distinct state concept such as risk state vs mailing state could be over-canonicalized.
assumptions.mitigation: Semantic alias rules are explicit and backward-compatible lookup remains in ScenarioData.

assumptions.decision: Random/date values are resolved once per scenario key and cached.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: If a test intentionally needs two different random values from the same key, reuse would be wrong.
assumptions.mitigation: Separate keys must be generated for independent values; cache behavior is documented in runtime-data-flow.

assumptions.decision: Buffers are either produced by a prior step or derived from canonical scenario inputs.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A true runtime-only extraction could be missing.
assumptions.mitigation: Unresolved buffers fail during quality audit or execution rather than carrying legacy expressions.

assumptions.decision: Source names prefixed by old/obsolete/zz are retained but isolated and tagged obsolete.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A team might still want to execute them in a special legacy suite.
assumptions.mitigation: Feature path and @obsolete/@legacy tags make filtering explicit.

assumptions.decision: Unsupported/custom engine operations are not invented as browser automation.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: Some business behavior may require a custom adapter.
assumptions.mitigation: Review-required classification keeps them visible outside the happy-path browser layer.
